(in-package #:mcclim-browser)
(setf (fdefinition 'canvas-region-mask) *original-mask*)
(defun canvas-clip-path (medium region)
  ;; Rectangle sets produced during text redisplay may include zero-area bands.
  ;; Their normalized components are +NOWHERE+, which contributes no contour.
  (when (eq region +nowhere+) (return-from canvas-clip-path nil))
  (typecase region
    (rectangle
     (multiple-value-bind (left top right bottom) (bounding-rectangle* region)
       (canvas-call medium "rect" left top (- right left) (- bottom top))))
    (polygon
     (let ((first t) (points nil) (area 0))
       (map-over-polygon-coordinates
        (lambda (x y) (push (cons x y) points)) region)
       (setq points (nreverse points))
       (loop for rest on points for a = (car rest) for b = (or (cadr rest) (car points))
             do (incf area (- (* (car a) (cdr b)) (* (car b) (cdr a)))))
       ;; Union paths must have the same winding, regardless of the input
       ;; polygon's vertex order, or overlapping regions could cancel out.
       (when (< area 0) (setq points (reverse points)))
       (dolist (point points)
         (canvas-call medium (if first "moveTo" "lineTo") (car point) (cdr point))
         (setf first nil))
       (canvas-call medium "closePath")))
    (ellipse
     (multiple-value-bind (cx cy) (ellipse-center-point* region)
       (multiple-value-bind (rx1 ry1 rx2 ry2) (ellipse-radii region)
         (let* ((start (or (ellipse-start-angle region) 0))
                (end (or (ellipse-end-angle region) (* 2 pi)))
                (reverse (< (- (* rx1 ry2) (* rx2 ry1)) 0)))
           (canvas-call medium "save")
           (canvas-call medium "transform" rx1 ry1 rx2 ry2 cx cy)
           (canvas-call medium "moveTo" (cos (if reverse end start)) (sin (if reverse end start)))
           (canvas-call medium "arc" 0 0 1 (if reverse end start) (if reverse start end)
                        (if reverse (ffi:ref "true") (ffi:ref "false")))
           (when (< (abs (- end start)) (* 2 pi)) (canvas-call medium "lineTo" 0 0))
           (canvas-call medium "closePath")
           (canvas-call medium "restore")))))
    ((or climi::standard-region-union climi::standard-rectangle-set)
     (map-over-region-set-regions (lambda (part) (canvas-clip-path medium part)) region :normalize :y-banding))
    ((or point line polyline elliptical-arc) nil)
    (t (error "Canvas clipping region is not yet supported: ~S" (type-of region)))))

(defun canvas-path-region-p (region)
  (or (eq region +nowhere+)
      (typecase region
        ((or rectangle polygon ellipse point line polyline elliptical-arc) t)
        ((or climi::standard-region-union climi::standard-rectangle-set)
         (every #'canvas-path-region-p (region-set-regions region)))
        (t nil))))

(defpackage #:valtan-drei-probe (:use #:clim #:clim-lisp))
(in-package #:valtan-drei-probe)
(defvar *frame* nil)
(defvar *answers* nil)
(defvar *phase* nil)
(defun phase (name stream)
  (setf *phase* name)
  (force-output stream)
  (mcclim-browser::host-call "status" (ffi:cl->js name)))
(defun top-level (frame)
  (let ((stream (find-pane-named frame 'editor)))
    (phase "Drei string ready" stream)
    (push (accept 'string :stream stream :prompt "Text") *answers*)
    (terpri stream)
    (phase "Drei integer ready" stream)
    (push (accept 'integer :stream stream :prompt "Number") *answers*)
    (terpri stream)
    (phase "Drei completion ready" stream)
    (push (accept '(member "alpha" "beta") :stream stream :prompt "Choice") *answers*)
    (phase "Drei finished" stream)))
(define-application-frame drei-probe-frame () ()
  (:menu-bar nil)
  (:panes (editor :interactor :scroll-bars nil :width 520 :height 220))
  (:layouts (default editor))
  (:top-level (top-level)))
(defun run ()
  (setf *answers* nil
        *frame* (make-application-frame 'drei-probe-frame
                   :frame-manager (frame-manager *application-frame*)
                   :pretty-name "Drei input checks" :left 40 :top 35 :width 520 :height 220))
  (unwind-protect (run-frame-top-level *frame*)
    (destroy-frame *frame*))
  (nreverse *answers*))
